n0.text: Switzerland congratulates the fountains, the monuments and the Reflecting Pool.

n1.text: Bern’s fountains have been running since the 16th century. Nobody has asked them to host the Ryder Cup.

n2.text: As for the screams of “FORE!”, we would suggest quiet hours after 10 p.m.

v0.text: A golf course on an island, in the capital?

v1.text: In Geneva, our island in the Rhône has a statue of Rousseau, and some ducks.

v2.text: Nobody shouts “FORE!”. Rousseau prefers to read.
